# A local new-branch collision remains a usage error with no worktree add or tab action.
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project branch feature/collision
assert-exit 64 zwm -C project co -b feature/collision
stderr '^zwm: usage: local branch .feature/collision. already exists\n$'
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG want-log

-- want-log --
{"sequence":1,"command":"git","args":["rev-parse","--show-toplevel"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
{"sequence":2,"command":"git","args":["worktree","list","--porcelain","-z"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
{"sequence":3,"command":"git","args":["check-ref-format","--branch","feature/collision"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
{"sequence":4,"command":"git","args":["rev-parse","--verify","--quiet","--end-of-options","HEAD^{commit}"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
{"sequence":5,"command":"git","args":["show-ref","--verify","--quiet","refs/heads/feature/collision"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
{"sequence":6,"command":"git","args":["worktree","list","--porcelain","-z"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
